svg.text: A smooth shake, and what a phone's browser reports (made-up waves)
the readings: 60 a second, each rounded to the nearest 0.1 m/s²
1. A firm tap: the shake comes through, in steps
2. A small shake, resting in the middle of a step: it vanishes
3. The same shake, resting near the edge of a step: the reading flickers, even before it
